E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hit and Run: Gloria tries to help Jay and Manny with their problems, but they're both unreceptive. Cam and Mitch are the victims of a hit-and-run accident. (S3 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: As Feedback Week continues, one bride decides she's had enough of the experts' advice and ignores them completely. (S13 Ep27)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boxer Kirsty puts her gloves down to find love. Ambitious Rose meets Hugo, who wears a cravat but has never been on a date. And can Holly kick the habit of falling for bad boys? (S23 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mill Street Bistro (Part 1/2): The owner of the Mill Street Bistro in Ohio claims to have the best menu between New York and LA. But the diners don't agree. (S6 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Marge-ian Chronicles: When Lisa signs up to participate in the future colonisation of Mars, Marge's attempt to use reverse psychology to discourage her goes badly wrong. (S27 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burns Cage: Homer makes it his mission to find romance for Smithers. Milhouse is jealous of Lisa's leading man when she's cast in the school production of Casablanca. (S27 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Aunt Mommy: After selling a house to Mitch and Cam's friends, Phil and Claire take them out for a celebratory dinner but get drunk and overshare. (S3 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Virgin Territory: It's a day of disturbing realisations when Mitchell manages to ruin one of Jay's proudest golf moments. Gloria stumbles upon Claire's dangerous little secret. (S3 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: As Feedback Week continues, one bride decides she's had enough of the experts' advice and ignores them completely. (S13 Ep27)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Next Top Model
E4Plus1.uk.description: The remaining all-stars are off to Greece. And what better way to embrace Greece's rich, storied history and culture than modelling lingerie in a giant bowl of Greek salad? (S17 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Shoddy Heat: Grampa finds himself embroiled in a cold case when the police unearth an old coffin with his business card in it - and two bodies. (S36 Ep4/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Women in Shorts: The women of Springfield take centre stage, with some special Simpsonified movie parodies including Barbie and The Chronicles of Narnia. (S36 Ep6/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Sound of Bleeding Gums: Lisa meets Bleeding Gums Murphy's deaf son Monk, and decides she has to help him - whether he wants help or not. (S33 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: Bec attempts to apologise for her text scandal at the sixth dinner party. But apparently that also involves shifting the blame onto someone else. (S13 Ep28)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: MAFS Australia: After the...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Dinner Party - Brand new series: Alissa, David and Joel unpack the screenshot saga, with some explosive unseen footage exposing the calculated manipulation behind the leak. (Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Eurovision, Citadel, The Greatest Auction, Family Fortunes, Open House: The Great Sex Experiment, I Kissed a Boy and The Big Celebrity Detox. (S21 Ep13)

Film4.uk.title: The Look of Love
Film4.uk.description: (2013) Comedy-drama biopic. Steve Coogan plays Paul Raymond, who ran Britain's first strip club, revolutionised the erotic entertainment industry and became rich. Strong language/sex/drugs.

Film4.uk.title: Wish You Were Here

Film4.uk.title: Forty Guns
Film4.uk.description: (1957) Western. Barbara Stanwyck stars as a cattle rancher who, with her hired guns, rules a town as if it were her own. But then a federal marshal (Barry Sullivan) arrives on the scene.

Film4.uk.title: Daddy's Home
Film4.uk.description: (2015) Comedy starring Mark Wahlberg, Will Ferrell and Linda Cardellini. A man's living happily with his wife and stepchildren - until the kids' biological dad swaggers back onto the scene.

Film4.uk.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
Film4.uk.description: (2014) Action-comedy with Colin Firth, Taron Egerton and Samuel L Jackson. A London teenager is introduced to a secret society of immaculately dressed agents that exists to save the world.

Film4.uk.title: Jennifer's Body
Film4.uk.description: (2009) Gory horror starring Megan Fox and Amanda Seyfried. A macabre ritual literally turns a cheerleader into a man-eater. Can her nerdy friend save the day?

Film4.uk.title: I Am Not a Witch
Film4.uk.description: (2017) Rungano Nyoni's BAFTA Film Award-winning satirical drama. In a rural Zambian village, a quiet, serious-looking girl is accused of witchcraft. In Nyanja/Bemba/Tonga/subs.

Film4.uk.title: Prince Valiant

Film4.uk.title: The Desert Fox
Film4.uk.description: (1951) Drama. James Mason stars in Henry Hathaway's sympathetic portrait of Field Marshal Erwin Rommel in the final years of his life during the Second World War. With Jessica Tandy.

Film4.uk.description: (1955) Western. Clark Gable plays a Civil War veteran who, with his brother (Cameron Mitchell), accepts the role of trail boss on a huge cattle drive for a crooked cattleman (Robert Ryan).

Film4.uk.description: (2011) Romance meets sci-fi thriller. Matt Damon and Emily Blunt star as a politician and a dancer who begin to suspect that a shadowy group of men are interfering with their lives.

Film4.uk.title: Knock at the Cabin
Film4.uk.description: (2023) M Night Shyamalan's jarringly intimate end-of-days horror with Dave Bautista. An armed group insist that a family of three must make an impossible life-or-death choice.

Film4.uk.description: (2022) Affecting drama with Virginie Efira as a single woman in her late 30s who wants children, and is falling in love with a man and his four-year-old daughter. In French/subs.
